findings.message: The Help & Lifecycle tab sets `link.href = entry.link.url` for every `snap.help` entry. `clutch/help.py` `help_map` (lines 234 and 240) builds links for topics whose doc is a shipped guide (`host-running.md` verb rows, `host-contract.md` command entries) as `{label, path, line}` with no `url`. Those topics therefore render as anchors with an undefined href that do nothing when clicked. The ticket requires `snap.help` topics and links to work.
findings.paved_road: Render a path-based link as a button or anchor whose click handler calls `openFile(entry.link.path)`. Keep `href`/`target=_blank` only for entries that have `link.url`. Add a path-only help entry to `tests/mcp_app_dashboard.js` and assert that clicking it sends a `toggle-aux-pane` request.

findings.message: `host.openHelp` only handles `snap.help[topic].link.url`. When `detail.js` calls `host.openHelp(topic)` (line 40) for a topic whose link is path-based (shipped `host-*.md` guide), nothing happens and no notice is shown. That help link is dead in the Details view.
findings.paved_road: In `openHelp`, call `openFile(link.path)` when the link has `path` and no `url`. Fall back to `window.open(link.url)` only for URL links. Cover both cases in the Node harness.
